name: a split whose units the broker states differently from its ratio: the broker's units stand, and the event is listed
spec: docs/plans/stage-2-engine.md, corporate events: the broker's own units are the statement of what moved
working: 100 X bought for 1,000; a two-for-one split, and the broker states 150 new units: 250 held, not the ratio's 200
the difference is listed; 250 sold for 1,500 → P&L 500

name: a split stated as units in and out on the same instrument agrees with its ratio
spec: docs/plans/stage-2-engine.md, corporate events: a split stated as units in and out
working: 100 X bought for 1,000; a two-for-one split the broker states as 100 out and 200 in: 200 held, as the ratio says, nothing listed

name: a consolidation the broker states in whole units, with cash in lieu of the fraction: the fraction is paid out, nothing listed
spec: docs/plans/stage-2-engine.md, corporate events: cash in lieu
working: 100 X bought for 1,000; one-for-eight: the ratio gives 12.5; the broker states 88 out, leaving 12, and pays the half unit in cash
the holding goes to the ratio's 12.5 (cost 1,000), and the cash leg closes the 0.5 the broker's units fell short by, at 40 per unit: 20 against 40 → −20
12 left, as the broker states; sold for 1,200 against 960 → 240; the round trip: 220
